listeningQuestions.audio: The Challenger carried the first civilian, an ordinary teacher, into space.
opts: 挑战者号把第一位平民——一名普通教师——送入太空。
挑战者号只运送了一些机器。
挑战者号从未离开过地面。
挑战者号载着一群游客去海边。

listeningQuestions.audio: Millions of families watched the first lunar landing on television.
opts: 数百万家庭在电视上观看了首次登月。
只有少数科学家知道这次登月。
人们在报纸上读到登月已是多年以后。
登月只是一部电影里的情节。

listeningQuestions.audio: Without gravity, astronauts must strap themselves down to sleep safely.
opts: 没有重力,宇航员必须把自己绑住才能安全睡觉。
宇航员在太空睡得比在地球更香。
宇航员睡觉时要开着所有的灯。

listeningQuestions.audio: A powerful telescope lets us see galaxies billions of light years away.
opts: 强大的望远镜让我们看到数十亿光年外的星系。
望远镜只能用来看近处的山。
望远镜让星星看起来更小了。
望远镜只在白天才能使用。

listeningQuestions.audio: We must keep reaching for the stars, no matter how distant they seem.
opts: 无论星辰多么遥远,我们都必须继续追寻。
星星太远了,我们应该放弃。
我们只该研究地球上的事。

listeningQuestions.audio: Real courage means doing the right thing even when you are afraid.
opts: 真正的勇气是即使害怕也去做对的事。
勇气就是从不感到害怕。
勇敢的人从不面对危险。
害怕的时候就该立刻逃走。

quizQuestions.q: Without gravity, an astronaut's bones and ____ slowly grow weak.
An ordinary teacher was about to become the first ____ in space.
After the disaster, the shuttle flights were ____ for nearly three years.
Through the telescope she watched the ____ surface of the Moon.
The lights are on and I hear voices, so the crew ____ be inside now.
You ____ checked the oxygen tank earlier; now it is far too late.
All astronauts ____ pass a strict medical check before any space flight.
He ____ have seen the comet last night; the sky was full of cloud.
Listen: 'The Challenger exploded just over a minute after take-off.' When did it explode?
opts: Just over a minute after take-off.
After a whole day in space.
quizQuestions.audio: The Challenger exploded just over a minute after take-off.

quizQuestions.q: Listen: 'Christa hoped to rekindle young people's interest in space.' What did Christa hope to do?
opts: Renew young people's interest in space.
quizQuestions.audio: Christa hoped to rekindle young people's interest in space.

reading.passage: The space shuttle Challenger carried an ordinary teacher who hoped to give lessons from orbit. Tragically, it exploded soon after take-off and all seven crew members were lost. Yet people were determined to keep exploring space.
reading.passageCn: 挑战者号航天飞机载着一名普通教师,她希望在太空轨道上讲课。不幸的是,它在起飞后不久爆炸,七名机组人员全部遇难。然而人们仍下定决心要继续探索太空。

questions.q: Who did the Challenger carry into space?
How did people respond after the disaster?
opts: They decided to keep exploring space.

writing.prompt: Write a few sentences about a space hero you admire. Say what they did and why their courage inspires you. Try to use modal verbs such as 'must' and 'could'.
writing.promptCn: 写几句话介绍一位你敬佩的航天英雄:他/她做了什么,为什么他们的勇气激励了你。试着用上 must、could 等情态动词。

lines.text: Hurry up! The rocket must be about to launch.
lines.cn: 快点!火箭一定快要发射了。

lines.text: Look at all that smoke and fire — the crew must be inside already.
lines.cn: 看那些浓烟和火焰——机组人员一定已经在里面了。

lines.text: They are so brave. I could never stay that calm.
lines.cn: 他们真勇敢,我绝不可能那么镇定。

lines.text: One day we should join a space camp and train like them.
lines.cn: 总有一天我们该去太空营,像他们一样训练。
